visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde-streaked hair stands in a bedroom, holding a large black commemorative box labeled 'WORLDS 25'. She wears a black T1-branded jacket with visible Red Bull and Mercedes-Benz logos. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her enthusiastic facial expressions and the glossy texture of the box. (2) She opens the box to reveal a multi-layered interior. The scene shifts to close-up shots of her hands interacting with the contents, including a gold-colored emblem on the lid and a pop-up display inside depicting a stylized map. (3) The character picks up a 'WINDUP MINIONS' box and unboxes two small toy figures, one red and one blue. She places them on the map and shows them moving. Her hands are the focus as she demonstrates the mechanical movement of the toys. (4) The woman showcases technical accessories, including a HyperX mouse in its retail packaging and a Mercedes-Benz branded keychain. She holds these items close to the camera for detailed visibility. (5) She unboxes a blue and white plush toy (Scuttle Crab) and a limited-edition card, showing the front and back. The background remains a soft-lit bedroom with a white bed and a clothing rack visible. (6) The video concludes with the woman giving a thumbs-up to the camera while holding the plushie, with her face centered in a medium close-up shot.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female main creator presenting the items.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian female with long hair, blonde on the front strands and brown behind. She wears a black professional e-sports jacket (T1 team wear) featuring multiple sponsor patches.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A domestic bedroom environment with a white bed, grey walls, and a clothing rack filled with garments visible in the background during wider shots.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female speech begins with a bright, enthusiastic tone. Upbeat electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat starts simultaneously. Subdued room tone exists in the background. (2) A clear 'thud' and 'rustle' occur as the box lid is opened. The speaker's pitch rises in excitement. (3) Continuous mechanical clicking sounds are heard as the wind-up toys are activated. A 'whoosh' transition sound effect punctuates a scene change. (4) Sharp plastic rustling sounds are prominent as individual packages are opened. The BGM remains consistent in volume, while the voice maintains high arousal. (5) A cartoon-style 'pop' sound effect accompanies the reveal of the plushie. (6) The video ends with a final energetic phrase from the speaker and a sharp fade out of the music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Itemized Reveal -> Emotional Climax -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves to showcase the premium contents of the 'Worlds 25' League of Legends commemorative collector's box. Through a high-energy unboxing format, it emphasizes the variety and exclusivity of the items (toys, peripherals, collectibles) to appeal to the gaming community and LoL fans.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly mentions being 'sponsored' by a friend/entity named 'Papa' (趴趴) for the unboxing, and the items are presented in a promotional manner.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A professionally edited, high-arousal unboxing video tailored for gaming social media, utilizing rapid cuts and synchronized sound effects to maintain viewer engagement.
